csv_project_name: Project Management Services for GLTS Addition & Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The Greater Lawrence Technical School is seeking the services of a qualified Owner's Project Manageras defined in Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 149 Section 44A12 and as further defined by the provisions of this RFQ, to provide Project Management Services for the design, construction, addition to and /or renovation of the Greater Lawrence Technical School in Andover, Massachusetts for a two (2) story masonry addition to the existing school consisting of approximately 12,000 square feet and consisting of medical laboratory classrooms.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering

title: Project Management Services for GLTS Addition & Renovation
short_description: Owner's project management for a school addition and renovation in Andover, Massachusetts.
project_scope: Project management services for the design and construction of an addition and/or renovation at Greater Lawrence Technical School. The described building measure is a two-story masonry addition to the existing school with approximately 12,000 square feet for medical laboratory classrooms.
services: Owner's Project Manager services as defined under Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 149 Section 44A1/2 for design and construction of the school addition and renovation.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily an owner's project management procurement, which is explicitly not a target service for sbp.
- The project is a small school building addition of about 12,000 square feet with no notable long-span, bridge, roof, or special structural features.
- Although structural engineering is listed among disciplines, the tender is not for structural design services.
- Educational buildings can be relevant when large or complex, but this project appears limited in size and technical ambition.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available scope information: two-story masonry addition, approximately 12,000 square feet, medical laboratory classrooms, plus renovation at an existing technical school. A rough construction-cost estimate might be possible externally, but the tender text alone does not provide a reliable basis for a defensible USD figure.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The procurement is for owner's project management services, not sbp's typical structural design scope, so an sbp fee cannot be derived reliably from the source.
references_qualifications: Qualified Owner's Project Manager as defined in Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 149 Section 44A1/2 and the RFQ provisions.
